task: H200 LoRA training throughput and memory selection for LLaDA TSP20

confirmation.selection: Baseline mb2/none once plus the fastest two safe primary configurations, each in two independent processes in alternating order. Duplicate baseline is not repeated outside selected top two.

capacity_extension.skip: Skip a larger microbatch after a measured OOM at the same rank/checkpointing; record as projected infeasible, never measured OOM.
capacity_extension.meaning: Separate throughput-only exploration; effective batch and optimizer update count change. Do not deploy without validation.

stress.data: longest examples in the same 512-example sample
stress.selection: best safe confirmed primary configuration per rank

memory_headroom_rule: max(6 GiB, 5% of CUDA-visible total), based on peak reserved memory
changing_effective_batch_note: Capacity trials adjust scheduler total steps for one epoch of the same 100k source examples. Same learning rate, no accuracy inference.
scope: Optimize execution among tested settings. No full training, no final quality claims, no changes to existing jobs or adapters.
